description: Bounded T1 sample-count comparison requested by the user, who removed the all-paper-metrics requirement. Same HP23 depth5 T1 75k actor/Adam/RNG parent and all hyperparameters as HP24 K4096 T1, with only N changed to8192. Five thousand additional updates, checkpoint77500 and80000. Compare N8192/80000 versus existing N4096/80000 at equal5000 additional updates, and N4096/85000 at equal40.96M additional target-density calls. N8192/77500 versus N4096/80000 is a second equal20.48M query checkpoint comparison. No new algorithm, objective, output transform or postprocessing. Native unbounded directg; T1,beta1,sigma1,epsilon1e-4/300,lr1e-4. This is tuning seed42 only. Do not start further open-ended sweeps solely to beat every metric.
